positions.title: Researcher & Developer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• First hire for an internal project-fund focused on applying fundamental factor modeling and trend-following strategies to long-tail digital asset markets
• Overhauled signal generation and backtesting infrastructure using high-performance computing libraries such as Numba and Cython
• Designed comprehensive tools for scenario analysis, stress testing, and parameter optimization
• Led the transition from CSV-based data systems to MongoDB, enabling more dynamic CRUD operations
• Managed relationships with data providers, evaluated API quality, and audited data reliability
• Doubled the number of factors in our model
• Crafted and delivered high-quality presentations to both technical and non-technical audiences
• Navigated complex regulatory challenges, contributing to the prudent decision to liquidate the fund

positions.title: Senior Analyst
positions.description:
• Collaborate with other analysts to pitch stocks for consideration as the next club investment
• Provide market updates at weekly general body meetings
• Propose outreach ideas and campaigns to enhance club's reach and access to opportunities

positions.title: Investment Banking Summer Analyst, Industrials & Activism Groups
positions.description:
• Tasked with independently building a predictive activist-target screen; 60% of my suggestions would go on to appear in the top-10 of Bloomberg’s Activism Index
• Constructed a detailed LBO model with independently sourced assumptions to inform suggestions of viable transactions for a major client

positions.title: Investment Banking Winter Analyst, Industrials Group
positions.description:
• Assisted in executing the $1bn sale of Cornerstone Building Brands’ IMP business to Nucor Insulated Panel Group
• Analyzed assumptions, structure, flow of client's five-year operating model and presented noteworthy conclusions to deal team
• Validated and integrated relevant data room submissions into our client’s CIP
• Cross-referenced extensive personal research on industry trends with client's operating model to help define their market and justify multiples; integrated findings into CIP

positions.title: Venture Capital Fall Analyst
positions.description:
• Research and gather data about industry-wide investment in URM-led startups to quantify current state of diverse VC investment
• Conduct original and unprecedented analysis to generate a conclusive list of potential partner VC firms; suggest actionable opportunities to increase diverse-founder deal flow
• Present findings to various outside firms and organizations
• First undergraduate intern in firm history; position expanded from summer intern to co-op intern

positions.title: Investment Banking Sophomore Summer Analyst, Consumer Retail Group
positions.description:
• Offered position for rising-senior internship in spite of only being a rising-junior; only such intern in North America
• Constructed comprehensive LBO models based on company and protein industry analysis to inform suggestions for viable transactions
• Screened potential acquisition targets and created representative presentation materials for client meetings
• Monitored and audited contents of virtual data rooms to improve the efficiency and comprehensiveness of due diligence process
• Analyzed company financials of players in Personal Care space to build various relative valuation benchmarks for a potential transaction

positions.title: Private Equity Analyst
positions.description:
• Researched, identified, and pitched industries that match Simetra Operator Fund’s investment criteria 
• Prospected acquisition candidates by assessing available information on private companies and evaluating them through qualitative and quantitative metrics

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description:
• Met and worked with over twenty clients through networking opportunities and referrals
• Collaborated with clients' parents to suggest lifestyle adjustments to improve discipline
• Drafted schedules and strategies to bolster student's productivity and self-sufficiency

positions.title: Photographer and Editor
positions.description:
• Networked with prospective clients through referrals and connections
• Oversaw all bookkeeping and marketing endeavors
• Managed all photography and videography for various benefits and events by 17

educations.fieldOfStudy: Concentration in Finance • Minor in Philosophy

educations.schoolName: New Explorations Into Science, Technology + Math (NEST+m)

honors.title: 2nd Place, Goldman Sachs Trade Pitch Competition
honors.description:
Overall accomplishment: One of 4 students to place Finalist in all 3 of Duke’s case competitions; only student to place top 3 in multiple competitions.

• Designed a merger arbitrage investment proposal centered on Google-Fitbit acquisition to generate uncorrelated returns in spite of market downturn
• Implemented leveraged options strategies to hedge downside and improve overall risk-adjusted returns
• Conducted extensive research into legal precedents of antitrust regulation in order to best understand deal completion probability
honors.issuer: Issued by Goldman Sachs, Duke Financial Economics Center · Apr 2020

honors.title: Arthur M. Goldberg Scholarship for "Overcoming Major Adversity"
honors.description: $20,000 scholarship awarded to Duke undergraduate in recognition of their triumph over major adversity. Awarded by nomination and only given to one student in the university.
honors.issuer: Issued by Arthur M. Goldberg and Veronica Goldberg Foundation, Inc. · Dec 2019

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Collaborate with a team of eight students to represent and advance student interests in department decisions and initiatives
• Proposed, coordinated, and currently executing modifications to Duke's Intro-Finance and Behavioral Finance class structure that will enhance student engagement and understanding through paper trading
• Driving initiative to improve outcomes for URM underclassmen interested in finance through targeted, personal mentorship

organizations.name: Duke SPIRE Fellow
organizations.description: Duke STEM Pathways for Inclusion, Readiness, and Excellence (SPIRE) is a fellowship for high-achieving undergraduates from diverse backgrounds with an interest in pursuing a major and/or career in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) fields.

organizations.name: Prep for Prep
organizations.description: Selected as 1 of 125 students for a highly selective leadership development program that incorporates a rigorous 14-month academic component to prepare students for placement in leading independent schools and continues to work closely with the students through high school graduation and beyond.
